title: Green diesel production via deoxygenation of triolein catalysed by nickel-molybdenum-supported catalysts
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37876-37887
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04601G, Paper

The deoxygenation of triolein into hydrocarbons has been carried out over NiO/CeO2, MoO2/CeO2 and NiO–MoO2/CeO2 under partial vacuum and solvent-free conditions.
